name: Technical Discovery & Architecture (SDLC Phase 3)
description: Defining technical architecture and system design — aka Solution Architecture, Systems Design, Tech Blueprint, Foundations Sprint.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Technical Discovery & Architecture
capabilities.description: Defines the technical architecture, data model, and integration strategy needed to build the product reliably at scale.

checklists.name: Technical Discovery & Architecture (SDLC Phase 3) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for system architecture, API specifications, data models, and non-functional requirements.

items.statement: Architecture decisions are documented with clear rationale and trade-offs rather than left implicit.
C4 diagrams (Context, Container, Component) clearly illustrate system boundaries and third-party dependencies.
API contracts specify strict payload schemas, HTTP status codes, error models, and rate limits.
Database entity-relationship diagram specifies primary keys, foreign keys, index strategies, and cascade rules.
Non-functional requirements specify explicit metrics for p95/p99 latency, target QPS, availability SLA, and RPO/RTO.

reviewGates.name: Architecture Review
reviewGates.statement: The Solution Architecture Document has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Security, Privacy & Compliance.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the Solution Architecture Document sufficiently detailed, consistent, and approved to guide implementation?
